edits.old: Then the first answer is returned
edits.new:
Then the first answer is returned

  Scenario: AC12 Business rules BR1 to BR9 (section 8)
    Given the rules of section 8 are read from the package and the parameters
    When the signed path runs
    Then each rule BR1 to BR9 holds as section 8 states

  Scenario: AC13 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given a request to a provided operation that the contract refuses with 401, 403 or 404
    When the request is answered
    Then the answer carries the status code that RWB-S2-E3008-CON defines for that refusal

  Scenario: AC14 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write has been answered under an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then no second decision record is written
    Then the first answer is returned

  Scenario: AC15 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event
    Given an event that the stage has already consumed
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then no second signature status, decision record or hand-over exists
    Then the first answer is returned

  Scenario: AC16 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the EvaluateRules activity times out or fails
    When the stage retries it
    Then no partial element leaves the stage

  Scenario: AC17 Disallowed status change is refused
    Given a case in a state that no rule of this story covers for CUSTOMER_SIGNED
    When CUSTOMER_SIGNED arrives
    Then no hand-over is returned
    Then the case status does not change

edits.old: | TC-E3-008-24 | BR9 | Component | The signed path runs with no approval step |
edits.new:
| TC-E3-008-24 | BR9 | Component | The signed path runs with no approval step |
| TC-E3-008-25 | AC12 | Component | BR1 to BR9 hold as section 8 states; each rule is also covered by TC-E3-008-16 to TC-E3-008-24 |
| TC-E3-008-26 | AC13 | Component | A refused request to a provided operation is answered with 401, 403 or 404 as RWB-S2-E3008-CON defines |
| TC-E3-008-27 | AC14 | Component | A replay of a write with the same idempotency key gives one decision record and the first answer |
| TC-E3-008-28 | AC15 | Component | A redelivered consumed event gives one signature status, one record and one hand-over |
| TC-E3-008-29 | AC16 | Component | A timed-out or failed EvaluateRules activity is retried and no partial element leaves the stage |
| TC-E3-008-30 | AC17 | Component | CUSTOMER_SIGNED in a state with no rule returns no hand-over and the case status does not change |
